thread_text:
Noah: Surprise drop-in: brought a mini piglet named Tofu for the afternoon. photo incoming 
Zara: WAIT. A PIGLET?? running over now :running_man:
Noah: uploaded: <https://imgur.com/a/tofu-office|tofu_desk.jpg>  he loves the sun patch and follows pens like a magnet 
Maggie: tiny snout! is he house-trained or is this chaos? :weary:
Noah: checked with people-ops before bringing him. short visit, supervised, towel on the floor. he knows "sit" and "snack" 
People-Ops Bot: Reminder: guest pets must be registered. Mini pigs allowed with prior approval; please upload vaccination/care docs and ensure common areas are cleared. See https://intranet/pets for details.
Devon: poll: Tofu's official desk title = 1) Snack Custodian 2) Chief Snout Officer 3) Keyboard Quality Assurance. react with :one:/:two:/:three:
Zara: reacts with :two: and :three: 
SnackBot: Friendly reminder: do not feed human snacks. Approved piglet treats: apple slices, plain cooked sweet potato. Please avoid chocolate, onions, and anything seasoned.
Maggie: posted a 6s clip: <https://youtu.be/tofu-sniff>  he gently nosed my coffee cup and then promptly ignored it for a paperclip 
Noah: Tofu is registered for today and vax docs uploaded. leaving a sign: "Tofu zone 437 please knock before petting" 
Devon: will bring a tiny bandana tomorrow if he's a repeat visitor. also volunteering to make a "Tofu was here" sticker 
Zara: adorably chaotic. quick Q: does he sleep in a basket or will he commandeer a chair? planning logistics.
Noah: basket preferred. brought a cozy carrier and a small pad. no chair-claiming so far :sweat_smile:
People-Ops Bot: Thanks for registering Tofu, Noah. If Tofu will be a recurring visitor, please submit a recurring pet schedule form."
